title: Walk 21: Sluice's move tried on this laptop, from the interface

steps.say:
21-0. What this walk needs, all on this laptop in your own account. Nothing is rented. It starts one task for porelo-message-sluice with Claude Code, attended, in the project sluice-dry, and its push reaches the real GitHub repository as a branch porelo/….

- The interface started from this checkout, the bundle directly (not flutter run):
  cd ~/git/porelo-frontend && flutter build linux --debug && build/linux/x64/debug/bundle/porelo_frontend
- Steps 1 to 5 of ~/.porelo/handover/porelo-project/sluice-dry/steps.md done first: the deploy key, the vault entries git.ssh.github.com and github-actions, and the credential check. Its steps 6 (follow) and 7 (your login in the room) are this walk's 21-1 to 21-4.
- The vault unlocked (Machines: this computer's lock is open).
- Element signed in to this laptop's homeserver, as in 6i-M1.
- The model calls of Claude in the task count on your Claude subscription.

Click Next in this panel.
21-1. In the rail click Projects, then Follow a project at the top of the page.

21-2. Fill in:
- What the project is called: sluice-dry
- Where the project's own repository is: /home/michi/.porelo/handover/porelo-project/sluice-dry/sluice-dry.bundle
- How its commits are checked: Only commits signed with this key
- The public key: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAICM5J65AMw2YWpWkI8iB3rFBnrMDK6zAVPabvs2dWzQs

Then click Follow it. Expected: it says what the machine read, sluice-dry with the repository sluice, and offers Go to it.
21-3. Click Go to it. Expected: the page of sluice-dry, online, with the repository sluice.

21-4. Under Work on that page click Messages and the project's room (also in the menu beside the title). Expected: Its room #porelo-sluice-dry, and who is in it. Where it says You are in as michi, you are in already: click Close and Next in this panel. Otherwise type michi as your name and click Join; copy the login it shows once into Element.
21-5. On the page of sluice-dry click Start work.

21-6. In the form: Which repository sluice; Name sluice; Which agent Claude Code; How you are involved A terminal (the default). Where it says Sign in to Claude Code first, click it and sign in in the terminal it opens, then come back.

The next click starts the task: the image builds once (a few minutes), then Claude starts. Click Start it. This panel moves on once the task's terminal is open.
21-7. Point 1, the task runs. Expected: the terminal of sluice opens in the interface, and Claude Code waits at its prompt. Type nothing there. Click Leave at the top right: the task keeps running.

21-8. Point 2, the room. In Element, the room #porelo-sluice-dry: an account Agent Sluice has joined (the name the project gives the repository sluice), and its first message is there. In the interface, under Work, the tile sluice; click Show more on it for its mini console.

21-9. Point 3, the wake (a model call). In Element write in the room:
Agent Sluice: please say hello in this room.
Expected: the mini console of sluice shows Claude waking, and its answer appears in the room.

21-10. Point 4, the gate. In Element write:
Agent Sluice: in doc/decisions.md, rewrite the paragraph that says a forge pull request fails the commit-message step so it says this is not yet measured on the forge. Commit it and push.
Expected: Claude says in the room it pushed, and on GitHub porelo-ai/porelo-message-sluice has a branch porelo/…. No Build starts (documents only). Open a pull request from that branch on GitHub by hand: the github reader opens none.

21-11. Point 5, the reader. Expected: the pull request starts the Shared rules check on GitHub; ask in Element:
Agent Sluice: what did the Shared rules check say?
It reads the run through the github reader and says green in the room.
21-12. Clean up. Under Work, on the tile sluice open its menu (⋮) and remove it. On GitHub close the pull request and delete the branch porelo/…. Then tell me here what was not as a step says.
